school_scope: The 31 schools in the requested comparison table; canonical working packages, including held PIs. This is not a website-release status report.

definitions.no_papers: PI counts.labPapers == 0; native school-corpus association, not lifetime publications or missing PDFs.
definitions.empty_roster: PI counts.students == 0; verified against actual students.json roster length; includes any role.
definitions.no_qualifying_students: Existing pi_coverage.student_facts qualifying == 0: graduate/alumni/unspecified student roles; excludes postdocs, staff, undergraduates and weak undated thesis/profile-only records. Missing records do not establish no real students.
definitions.comparison: Changes use the saved November 19 evening package snapshot. Its nested earlier baseline is retained separately, with no new timestamp inferred.

verification: NTU: five schema checks per applied batch; all original scientific rows, student rosters and issued identifiers retained. Every coverage input was hashed before and after the recount.
